## Terms

### Realm Object Model

- **Realm Object Model** · self — Realm object models support relationships through references to other model objects and typed collections. The inspected Swift implementation also exposes LinkingObjects for inverse links, alongside List, MutableSet, and Map collections. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/realm/realm-swift/blob/master/RealmSwift/Object.swift
